title: Leftover SetError misuse in guides and scene-00
description: Found while fixing jmap-chat-spec-up1n (91672c9), left out of scope: (1) jmap-did-guide.md L332/L339 says invalidArguments, draft-atwood-jmap-did-00 L204 says invalidProperties. (2) jmap-chat-push-platform-guide.md L58 and jmap-vtc-implementer-guide.md L746 use invalidArguments as a SetError. (3) scene-00 uses notFound for create-time dangling references (L751, SceneObject table); RFC 8620 allows notFound only for update/destroy. (4) jmap-scene-implementer-guide.md lists stateMismatch as a SetError; RFC 8620 makes it method-level.
